name: Deep Freeze · Cold ×5
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 3.62-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Cold 288: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Cold 80: extinguishes and slows, freezes for 4 s at 100 built-up cold (×2.5 on wet); puddles freeze
• Slowness III for 9 s
